notes.title: Update v1.03 – Faster Turns
notes.content: If you move the mouse to the far left or right edge of the screen you will continue to turn. The closer to the edge the faster you will turn. This enables you to make faster turns or turn/spin on the spot. Thanks for the feedback.

notes.title: Update v1.02 – In-Game Introduction
notes.content: Thanks for the feedback. I've added a few simple screens explaining the basics of the game. Just click on the How to Play button found on the opening screen.

notes.title: Update v1.01 - Camera Bounce
notes.content: Thanks for the feedback. I've removed the camera bounce - however you can toggle it back on (and off) using the B key.
